- 9:00-10:00 – Next class

- 10:15-12:00 – Open block (rest, notes, errands)
- 12:00-12:30 – Rice bowl, sitting down
- 12:30-2:15 – Study or nap
- 2:15-2:45 – Pack up, head to the cafe

Got it, so no gap between the exam and anatomy. Here's the tightened version:

- 8:00-9:00 – Chem midterm
- 9:00-10:00 – Anatomy (grab water on the way)
- 10:00-10:30 – Decompress: snack, walk, no studying
- 10:30-11:45 – Anatomy review, quick pass over today's notes
- 11:45-12:30 – Rice bowl, phone away
- 12:30-1:45 – Rest or nap
- 1:45-2:30 – Light flashcards or errands
- 2:30-2:40 – Pack up
- 2:40-2:55 – Bike to the cafe
- 3:00-9:00 – Closing shift

I put the rice bowl well ahead of the shift so you're not running on empty at the espresso machine.
